description.value: Bianca Amor's Liquidation Supercentre is a 100% Canadian-owned discount chain that has been selling surplus and closeout merchandise across Western Canada for over 25 years, with 17 locations province-wide. Each visit is described as an adventure — inventory rotates constantly and includes food, household goods, décor, and other everyday essentials at steep discounts. The Surrey location at 15340 104 Avenue is one of two BC stores alongside a Coquitlam outlet.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate, open liquidation supercentre at 15340 104 Avenue, listed under the 'Surrey' location on the /locations page — the OSM community field 'North Vancouver' appears to be incorrect. The website mentions food and household items in its inventory, supporting a partial grocery claim, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. The OSM tag 'shop=convenience' misrepresents the business; it is a large-format liquidation chain, not a convenience store.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the website's own /locations page places 15340 104 Avenue under the 'Surrey' location — coordinates (49.19N, 122.80W) also confirm Surrey, not North Vancouver.
OSM tag 'shop=convenience' misclassifies this business; it is a large-format liquidation supercentre.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website for this specific location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a large-format liquidation chain that carries food but is not a dedicated grocery or cycling stop; no bike infrastructure or cyclist-focused amenities are documented. May have limited utility for touring cyclists given unpredictable inventory, but could serve as an occasional resupply point.
enrichment_extras.notes: Food availability is real but stock is unpredictable due to the liquidation model — cyclists should not rely on finding specific items.

provenance.category_correction_reason: This is a liquidation supercentre that carries food among many other product categories; it is not a dedicated grocery or convenience store. 'Groceries' is a marginal fit at best.

wow_evidence: 100% Canadian-owned discount chain ... 17 locations province-wide ... over 25 years
